count_once_rule: One detection per change. A truth of a linked key (config.SAME_CHANGE: D9- measures the D1- change) is detected by its own-key region (IoU >= 0.5) or its own-key whole-clip flag; when there is none, the same-change region with the largest |z| within half a window (2 words) is the detection, without an IoU test. Every other same-change region of that change is a duplicate, not a false region. A second own-key region on the same edit that fails IoU is a false region.
